--- source ---
  static float dist, n, x, y, ang;
  glClearColor(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1);
  dist = 1.4;
  n = 400;
  glBegin(GL_LINE_LOOP);
    for(i, 0, n) {
      ang = TAU * i/n;
      x = dist * cos(t*ang) + cos(ang);
      y = dist * sin(t*ang) + sin(ang);
      glVertex3f(x, y, 0);
    }
  glEnd();
